brand.name: PARÉ
brand.tagline: Brand systems, reduced to what matters.
brand.category: Sovereign in-house brand software / installable Brand OS
brand.origin_story: PARÉ consolidates Pauli Brand Studio's ICM brand intelligence, One Hands orchestration, independent design validation and replaceable execution/publishing adapters into software that can be installed and adapted to a company without mandatory subscription lock-in.

strategy.positioning_statement: For companies that need a serious internal brand capability without handing their identity to another subscription dashboard, PARÉ is an installable brand operating system that turns company context into governed strategy, identity, production assets, voice, SEO, social and delivery packages because canonical intelligence stays portable, workers are replaceable adapters, and consequential outputs require independent proof.
strategy.brand_promise: A company can leave with a brand system it can understand, operate, move and keep.
proof_points: The existing Brand Studio repository already uses ICM stages, manifests, ledgers, independent validation and portable project folders.
PARÉ exposes common request/workflow semantics across CLI, MCP and REST implementations in the repository.
Self-host packaging keeps project intelligence in owner-controlled persistent storage and treats Darya/Postiz as optional runtime adapters.

differentiation.everybody_zigs: Brand generators optimize for fast assets, static brand guides stop at documentation, and many SaaS tools make their dashboard/provider part of the operating dependency.
differentiation.we_zag: PARÉ installs a governed brand operating system around portable company truth, production asset engineering, search/social consistency, replaceable workers and evidence-backed human gates.

primary.description: Founders, executives, creative/marketing leads, social-purpose organizations and culturally sensitive brands that value high craft, ownership and operational simplicity.
psychographics: wants professional brand quality without generic AI output
cares about control of code, assets, data and operating knowledge
prefers one coherent method over a collection of disconnected tools
will pay for installation/customization when it reduces long-term dependency

tone_rules.do: Use concrete language about ownership, outcomes, proof and how the software works.
tone_rules.dont: Lead with AI jargon, luxury adjectives, vague innovation claims or fear-based SaaS rhetoric.

tone_rules.do: Use the exact PARÉ status language contract and name missing evidence clearly.
tone_rules.dont: Call generated, configured, deployed or CI-passing work Official, Production or Done without the required proof.

tone_rules.do: Explain decisions through strategy, culture, audience, material and application.
tone_rules.dont: Use fashionable references as permission to copy another brand's protected expression.

protected_items: Brand systems, reduced to what matters. tagline
customer ownership / no mandatory subscription lock-in
production and external publish require recorded human approval
hard_bans: AI brand kit generator as primary positioning
raster logo concepts represented as official vector masters
secret material in portable brand intelligence
mandatory Pauli hosting as a condition of continued use
